children: Momentum Financial Services Group renewed and upsized its secured loan facility with Ares to C$810M, added an accordion up to C$130M, and extended the term through January 2029 to support growth and new product launches.
Boosts lending capacity to fund receivables growth; signals confidence from lender.
Incremental capital supports scaling without immediate equity dilution.
Provides optional additional liquidity if growth outpaces plans.
Reduces near-term refinancing risk; improves funding visibility.
Funds new products in CA & U.S.
Potential revenue expansion; timing and uptake remain key unknowns.

This extends a funding trend aligned with reported Canadian receivables growth, reinforcing balance-sheet support for expansion. A larger catalyst would be disclosed uptake metrics or revenue impact from the planned product launches, or any change in facility pricing/terms.
